sources.title: GLM-5.3-Flash | Unsloth Documentation
sources.snippet: GLM-5.3-Flash, also known as ox-alpha, is Z.ai's new 320B parameter multimodal open model with 18B active parameters. GLM-5.3-Flash outperforms GLM-5.2 across benchmarks and real-world workloads at one-tenth the price, while approaching Claude Opus 4.8 on coding and agentic benchmarks. This article is a WIP.

sources.title: GLM-5.3-Flash: Shattering the Cost-Performance Frontier in AI
sources.snippet: The artificial intelligence landscape often demands a steep trade-off between capability and cost, but GLM-5.3-Flash fundamentally rewrites this equation. Previously tested under the radar as the wildly popular model ox-alpha, this new release is the first natively multimodal system in the GLM-5 lineup.
